mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) reduce the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and SPX 20-day returns is greater than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation, as measured by CPIAUCSL exceeding 250, signals increased economic uncertainty and potential central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 250, the combination signals a high-risk environment with low policy rates and high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 250.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0), the economy is operating near full employment, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity, as measured by HOUST exceeding 1000 thousand units, signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1000.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 100 and employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 140000 thousand persons, the economy is in a strong expansion phase, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100 AND PAYEMS > 140000.

mechanism_narrative: Higher levels of retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between RSAFS and SPX 60-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0.
